semantic_contract: return zero without formatting when *ppos is nonzero
clear the 200-byte local output buffer and invoke the optional callback at cdev + 0xe20 with the KCFI type preserved
format TP module, IC type, I2C address, SPI number, firmware, config, display, chip-hard and firmware-update fields using the stock offsets and conditional guards
reject lengths greater than 200 through the stock non-returning brk #0x5512 path
copy the generated output through simple_read_from_buffer and preserve the stack-canary check

normalized_instruction_differences: callback pointer load is scheduled after local-buffer zeroing in the candidate
the overflow brk block and stack-check failure call are emitted in opposite physical order while preserving their branch destinations and effects
module-local branch and rodata relocation addresses differ

follow_up_required: Review the Joern userspace_egress finding for simple_read_from_buffer against the target 6.12 ABI before hardware promotion.
Keep register scheduling and terminal-block layout differences separate from semantic parity; require a dedicated compiler-layout investigation if byte-level parity becomes mandatory.
Run controlled procfs/userspace read and NX809J runtime validation only after the offline driver set is complete.
unverified: actual userspace copy and fault behavior in the target kernel
callback lifetime and KCFI trap behavior under concurrent teardown
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, matching 168-instruction/672-byte body size and normalized control/data flow, matching KCFI type and size, strict Joern graph gate with one explicit userspace-egress finding, reproducible Docker build, and two-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract. No smartphone test was performed.
